mapper.select: SELECT C.CUST_NO, C.CUST_NM, C.GRADE_CD FROM TB_CUST C WHERE C.CUST_NO = #{custNo} AND C.STAT_CD = '01'
SELECT A.ACCT_NO, A.ACCT_KIND_CD, A.BAL_AMT, A.OPEN_DT FROM TB_ACCT A WHERE A.CUST_NO = #{custNo} AND A.STAT_CD = '01' ORDER BY A.OPEN_DT DESC
SELECT BAL_AMT FROM TB_ACCT WHERE ACCT_NO = #{acctNo} AND STAT_CD = '01'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ACCT SET BAL_AMT = BAL_AMT + #{trnAmt}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ACCT_NO = #{toAcctNo} AND STAT_CD = '01'
